gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross release from prior year reserves of GBP 69.6 million in 2016. This release contributed to the overall underwriting loss. The claims ratio deteriorated due to large catastrophe losses experienced during the year and the impact of the Ogden rate change. While there were overall releases, some business units experienced strengthening from adverse attritional experience and material large loss development, particularly in Marine and Aviation (GBP 23.0m strengthening) and Property and Casualty (GBP 33.0m strengthening due to Ogden rate changes). Reinsurance recoveries and the syndicate's reserving policy of holding reserves above actuarial best estimate also influenced the movements. Inadequate case reserves for known large losses and catastrophes or from inadequate provision for IBNR claims were also noted as areas of uncertainty.
